            # Sole experimental change: independent binary logistic loss.
            # Each example contributes its positive loss plus the mean loss
            # over valid negatives, with equal weight across examples.
            # Invalid negatives contribute neither gradients nor denominator
            # mass; examples without valid negatives retain only positive loss.
            positive_loss = F.softplus(-scores[:, 0].float())
            negative_scores = scores[:, 1:].float().masked_fill(~allowed, 0.0)
            negative_loss = F.softplus(negative_scores).masked_fill(
                ~allowed, 0.0
            ).sum(dim=1) / allowed.sum(dim=1).clamp_min(1)
            loss = (positive_loss + negative_loss).mean()
